description: Trigger evals for the installed skill library. Measures two things a single-skill eval cannot: whether a skill fires when it should (misses), and whether the wrong skill fires (crowding). Queries are drawn from real work in these repos, not invented.
notes: expect_skill is the skill that should handle the query. null means no skill should fire — the task is ordinary work Claude does directly. A query answered by a *different* skill than expect_skill is a crowding failure, which is the thing this eval exists to find.
